eva.title: Ridge and hollow transect
eva.goal: Sample a boxwork ridge and the hollow beside it to test how groundwater cemented the ridges.

stops.name: Altadena
stops.what: Drilled over the weekend; hole imaged by Mastcam sol 4564. First boxwork-unit drill; CheMin found phyllosilicates largely absent from surrounding Layered Sulfate unit (GSA 2025).
stops.task: Crew rover parks at Curiosity's first boxwork drill site. Suit checks, then walk south.

stops.name: Volcán Peña Blanca
stops.what: Imaged from ~10 m on sol 4591; contact science on upper (Parinacota, DRT+APXS) and middle (Wila Willki) outcrop; LIBS Pichu Pichu, Tacume. Phase 2 stop.
stops.feature: prominent raised ridge with side + top view, at least three layers
stops.task: Raised ridge with at least three layers in its wall: sample each layer from bottom to top.

stops.name: Salar de Agua Amara
stops.feature: delicate branching structures 'likely made by groundwater'
stops.task: Delicate branching structures likely made by groundwater: image in place, then core beside them.

stops.name: Río Frío wall
stops.what: MAHLI pea-sized nodule image on sol 4636 (PIA26697).
stops.feature: nodule-filled target (APXS) and a vein (LIBS) at the Rio Frio ridge wall
stops.task: Nodule-filled ridge wall and a vein: compare nodule and vein chemistry.

stops.name: Monte Grande hollow
stops.what: Hollow with exposed bedrock, studied from sol 4673. Revisited sols 4743-4749 for the polygon-patterned blocks.
stops.feature: large hollow with exposed bedrock and polygon-patterned blocks
stops.task: Hollow floor with exposed bedrock and polygon blocks: collect the hollow sample.

stops.name: Nevado Sajama ridge
stops.what: 'The drill activity itself completed on Sol 4718.' Ridge sample: clay minerals (JPL). Site of 1.5-gigapixel 360 deg panorama, sols 4714-4741.
stops.feature: drill hole #45 on the ridge top. The hollow drill hole, Valle de la Luna, is about 10 m to the north.
stops.task: Ridge top Curiosity drilled, 10 m from its hollow drill hole Valle de la Luna: collect the matching ridge sample.

stops.name: Timboy Chaco
stops.task: Pitted vertical rock face at the eastern edge of the boxwork.
